description: Execute a read-only SQL SELECT query against the IBM Db2i database. Only SELECT statements are allowed for security. Results are limited by default to prevent large result sets.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default: QUERY_DEFAULT_LIMIT, max: QUERY_MAX_LIMIT)

name: execute_query

cause.description: Why the statement failed. &1-style placeholders stand for values in error.

recovery.description: What to change before trying again

skippedFilters.description: Annotated tables whose row filter, such as leaving out deleted rows, the query does not use. See warnings

sqlcode.description: SQLCODE of the failed statement, such as -204

truncated.description: True when the result stopped at limitApplied and more rows match

warnings.description: Tell the user these, such as columns the driver rounded

title: Execute SQL Query
